text.tspan: domingo, 8 de noviembre de 2026, 6:40 p.m. hora de Ecuador

Step-up with dynamic linking: a transfer to a new beneficiary over the threshold needs a fresh acr:3 confirmation bound to amount and beneficiary (RFC 9470 + RFC 9396). A stolen acr:2 token can't move this money (Step 6, ADR-007).
